prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1012; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred at an intersection, in which our client's vehicle was struck on the side by another vehicle. Our client sustained injuries as a result of the impact and is now seeking appropriate compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Any statements or requests should be routed through our firm.

We ask that you provide the complete policy limits of liability coverage applicable to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this incident, along with a copy of the declarations page.

Your company is also on notice of its obligation to preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim file materials, vehicle inspection reports, and any signal or traffic camera footage in your possession. Please take steps to ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.
